facts.text: I am looking for inspiration for my next crochet project.
I want a simple yet elegant scarf pattern for my sister's birthday.
I have been enjoying using my new Copic markers to add colorful touches to my handmade cards and gift tags lately.
I am considering an ombre scarf idea.
I have a lot of worsted weight yarn in my stash.
I am not sure whether my worsted weight yarn would be too thick for an ombre effect.
I will go with fingering weight yarn for a more subtle effect.
I have leftover yarn from my crochet projects.
I have soft pastel shades of yarn that I think would work well for an ombre effect.
I have been using my Copic markers to add colorful touches to my handmade cards and gift tags.
I am thinking of decorating the gift tag for the scarf with matching pastel colors.
I am thinking of adding a small, delicate flower to the gift tag.
I am thinking of adding subtle shading to the flower using my Copic markers to give it depth.
I have been experimenting with different types of embroidery floss and threads.
I am thinking of using matching pastel-colored floss to add simple embroidery details to the gift tag.
I am thinking of adding a small, delicate stem to the flower using matching embroidery floss.
I am thinking of adding a small, coordinating bead or sequin to the center of the flower for extra embellishment.
